actions.description: Run one single-sequence acquisition and wait for it to finish (the native sample)
actions.name: single_acquisition

outputs.description: True once the scope has finished the single acquisition
outputs.name: acquired

actions.description: Stop the acquisition (ACQ:STATE STOP); this is the safe state and takes no input
actions.name: stop_acquisition

outputs.description: True after ACQ:STATE STOP has been sent
outputs.name: stopped

facts.text: The repository README describes a system for controlling an oscilloscope with a ready-to-use driver for the Tektronix TDS3054C
The TDS3054C class is the repository's oscilloscope driver; it connects to the scope's HTTP server over an AF_INET TCP socket
test_connection queries *IDN? and accepts the device only when the reply contains 'TDS 3054C'
Every command is an HTTP POST to /Comm.html whose body is COMMAND=<command>&gpibsend=Send
set_channel accepts only channels 1 to 4 and writes DATA:SOURCE CH<n>
set_channel_state writes SELECT:CH<n> ON or OFF
set_vertical_scale writes CH<n>:SCAle and set_vertical_position writes CH<n>:POSition
set_horizontal_scale writes HORizontal:MAIn:SCAle and set_horizontal_position writes HORizontal:MAIn:POSition
get_horizontal_increment queries WFMPre:XINcr? and returns the device reply
The Slope enum allows only the values RISE and FALL
set_trigger_slope writes TRIGger:A:EDGE:SLOpe only for the two Slope values
set_trigger_channel accepts only channels 1 to 4 and writes TRIGger:A:EDGE:SOUrce CH<n>
sample stops the current acquisition, arms a single sequence, starts ACQ:STATE ON and polls BUSY? until 0
SELECT? may return the channel states followed by CONTROL CH<n>, which names the selected waveform

measures.description: Horizontal time increment between waveform samples (WFMPre:XINcr?)
measures.name: horizontal_increment

operator_required.name: vertical_scale
operator_required.reason: the clone writes CH<n>:SCAle without validating or stating a vertical scale range; the site supplies the range of its probe and scope

operator_required.name: vertical_position
operator_required.reason: the clone writes CH<n>:POSition without validating or stating a vertical position range; the site supplies the usable range of its scope

operator_required.name: horizontal_scale
operator_required.reason: the clone writes HORizontal:MAIn:SCAle without validating or stating a horizontal scale range; the site supplies the range of its scope

operator_required.name: horizontal_position
operator_required.reason: the clone writes HORizontal:MAIn:POSition without validating or stating a horizontal position range; the site supplies the usable range of its scope

operator_required.name: trigger_level
operator_required.reason: the clone writes TRIGger:A:LEVel without validating or stating a trigger level range; the site supplies the range of its signal and scope

safe_state.description: acquisition stopped (ACQ:STATE STOP); the scope output is not software-controlled
